scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

components.basis: Conservative32 temporary slots for default codegen partitioning/metadata/object emission; emit=obj, no save-temps/incremental/debug archives
Three temporary slots per fixed one-TU witness compile, including assembly/intermediate/driver file
Single driver TU assembly/object, collect2/linker temporary files and transient final artifact; no LTO/plugin/save-temps commands
Seven stdout plus seven stderr regular files. Reserve full64MiB RLIMIT_FSIZE each even though capture hashing later rejects above32MiB and leaf proposals16KiB are not aggregate enforcement
Grant/admission/argv/start/join/results records plus bounded nm/readelf/qualification captures
All compiler temporaries routed to same private leaf output; directory/metadata rounding allowance
One GiB beyond enumerated outputs before reservation rounding

temporary_location_binding: First six commands use pinned /usr/bin/env TMPDIR=<private leaf output> before exact compiler executable. Runner creates leaf before first command. Harness opens no files; captures are separate same-HOST paths.
limits: Existing runner per-file64MiB limit is not a count or aggregate output limit. This is a planning reserve for these exact ordinary pinned sources/tools/commands, not a universal compiler output-count guarantee or new quota.
failure_behavior: Original runner preserves first failure and successful prefix. No automatic replay or cleanup. Existing admission requires HOST16GiB plus the full8GiB reserve on each command; scratch12GiB and memory/oneheavy/aggregate limits unchanged.
